spec.description: How often the indicators on it are read: the length of a period and when the cycle's year starts. The periods themselves are derived, never stored.

name.description: Deprecated: the name is metadata.name, as Kubernetes keeps it. Read from a manifest saved before 2.6.0 and folded into metadata.name; never written.

periodMonths.description: How long one period is, in months: monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or yearly. A KPI read on this cycle has one reading per period (TAXONOMY.md D8).

startMonth.description: The month the cycle's year starts in, 1 to 12, so periods line up with it (a financial year from April is 4). A period is named by the month it ends.

dueOffsetDays.description: How many days after a period ends its reading is due.
